title: Invoice routes accept anonymous callers: list, read, create (any store, any number) and cancel any invoice
steps: 1) No token: GET /api/invoices?store_id=2 ; GET /api/invoices/1. 2) POST /api/invoices {store_id:2, invoice_number:"QA-NOAUTH-1", items:[...]}. 3) POST /api/invoices/1/cancel {reason:"probe"}
expected: 401 for every call; cancel needs approval and store scope
actual: 200 list/read; 201 invoice id 3 created in store 2 with client number QA-NOAUTH-1 and counter_id 1; 200 cancel of INV-PKD-1001 ("batch stock restored") with no user
cause: backend/routes/api.php:173-178 register /invoices, /invoices/{id}, /invoices/{id}/cancel and /invoices/{id}/lock outside any auth middleware (counter.profile only). InvoiceController::resolveStoreId() trusts body/header/query store_id and falls back to Store::first(); InvoiceController::cancel() does Invoice::findOrFail($id) with no store or role check.
fix: Move these routes inside [counter.auth, counter.profile] (till) or auth:sanctum + scope.store (panel). Derive the store only from the token, scope every findOrFail by store, require approval for cancel.
test: Feature test that walks Route::getRoutes() and fails for any /api route without an auth middleware unless on an explicit allowlist (claim, login, health, update manifest); anonymous POST /invoices and /invoices/{id}/cancel return 401.

title: Anonymous POST /api/settings overwrites store settings; GET /api/settings and /api/sync/pull/deltas return any store's settings and full catalogue
steps: No token: GET /api/settings?store_id=2 ; GET /api/sync/pull/deltas?store_id=2 ; POST /api/settings {}
actual: 200 with store 2 settings and store 2 products/batches; POST answers "Store settings saved successfully."
cause: backend/routes/api.php:89 (/sync/pull/deltas) and :137-139 (/settings) are public; AdminSettingController::update and SyncController::pullDeltas resolve the store from the request.
fix: Require the device token or an admin token and resolve the store from it.
test: Anonymous GET/POST /api/settings and GET /api/sync/pull/deltas return 401.

title: Anonymous callers can unlock workstations, take invoice locks and read held bills, negative-stock report, WhatsApp config and licence
steps: No token: POST /api/device-sessions/1/unlock ; POST /api/invoices/1/lock ; GET /api/held-bills ; GET /api/inventory/negative-stock-report ; GET /api/whatsapp/config
actual: 200 "Workstation 'Admin Console' unlocked."; "Invoice lock acquired by counter C01"; the rest 200 with data. WhatsApp config also exposes a production host (wa-api.alverstone.in).
cause: backend/routes/api.php:154-204: device-session, held-bill, whatsapp, negative-stock and lock routes sit outside every auth group; DeviceSessionController::unlock() has no caller check.
fix: Put them under device.auth or auth:sanctum with store scope.
test: Same route-allowlist test as SEC-01.

title: Store state code and code accept any text (e.g. "3232", "STORE-04QA-PH"); GSTIN state prefix not checked against state code
steps: Admin panel > Stores > Add Store Branch: keep the prefilled 32 and type 32 (field shows 3232); save. Or PUT /api/admin/stores/4 {state_code:"32332"}.
expected: state_code must be a valid 2-digit GST state code (01-38, 97) matching the GSTIN prefix; store code format validated
actual: Saved state_code 3232 / 32332 and code STORE-04QA-PQA-PH (201/200). Place-of-supply (CGST+SGST vs IGST) is decided from this value.
cause: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/AdminStoreController.php:86 and :147 validate state_code as "required|string|max:10" only.
fix: Validate state_code with a regex/in-list of GST state codes, require GSTIN[0..1] == state_code when GSTIN is present, validate store code charset.
test: Feature test: POST /api/admin/stores with state_code 3232 or GSTIN prefix mismatch returns 422.

title: Store form State Code field cannot be cleared: it snaps back to "32", so typing a new code appends to it
steps: Admin panel > Stores > Edit a store; select the State Code text, press Backspace, type 29.
expected: Field shows 29
actual: Field shows 3229 (empty value is replaced by "32" on every render).
cause: admin-panel/src/pages/StoresPage.tsx:450 value={editingStore.state_code || "32"}
fix: Bind value={editingStore.state_code ?? ""} and apply the default only when the form opens.
test: DOM test: clear State Code then type 29 -> value is 29.

title: Fresh install seed fails: DatabaseSeeder calls data:sync-actual, which imports ../lamsuite_desktop.sqlite and hits UNIQUE(products.store_id, barcode)
steps: cd backend; DB_DATABASE=<new file> php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
expected: Seed completes with fake demo data only
actual: SQLSTATE[23000] UNIQUE constraint failed: products.store_id, products.barcode; the seeder also pulls rows from a local desktop database into the server.
cause: backend/database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php:616 Artisan::call('data:sync-actual'); backend/app/Console/Commands/SyncActualDataCommand.php:91 reads base_path('../lamsuite_desktop.sqlite').
fix: Remove the data:sync-actual call from the seeder (make it an explicit opt-in command) and make the import idempotent per (store_id, barcode).
test: CI job runs migrate:fresh --seed on an empty sqlite file.

title: Admin product with opening stock fills the batch but leaves products.current_stock at 0 and writes no stock-ledger entry
steps: Admin panel > Masters > Add Product (store QA-PH): QA Cough Syrup 100ml, Batch CS-A1, Expiry 2027-06-30, Stock Quantity 40; save.
expected: Batch CS-A1 qty 40, product current_stock 40, one opening-stock ledger row (+40) so ledger = batch balance
actual: POST /api/admin/products 201 with initial_batch.stock_qty 40: product_batches.stock_qty = 40, products.current_stock = 0, stock_ledger_entries = 0 rows. Same for QA Ruby Lipstick (25) in QA-CS.
cause: AdminMasterController (admin products store) creates initial_batch directly on ProductBatch without going through the stock posting service that maintains products.current_stock and stock_ledger_entries.
fix: Post opening stock through the same stock-movement service used by purchases/adjustments (event_type opening_stock) inside the create transaction.
test: Feature: create product with initial_batch qty 40 -> current_stock 40 and sum(stock_ledger_entries.qty_delta) for the batch = 40.

title: Every admin-created product gets a phantom zero-quantity batch "B1" with an invented expiry (today + 1 year)
steps: Admin panel > Add Product, leave Stock Quantity 0 (Batch No is prefilled B1, Expiry prefilled today+1y); save.
expected: No batch is created when no stock is entered
actual: product_batches row B1, expiry 2027-11-21, stock_qty 0 for QA Paracet 500 Strip, QA Alprazolam, QA Glow Face Cream.
cause: admin-panel/src/pages/MastersPage.tsx always sends initial_batch with defaults; backend accepts a zero-qty initial batch.
fix: Send initial_batch only when quantity > 0; backend ignores zero-qty initial batches; do not prefill an expiry.
test: DOM test: product with stock 0 posts no initial_batch; feature test: zero-qty initial batch creates no row.

title: Activation lockout is per IP: five wrong codes from any till on the shop network block every till behind that IP for 15 minutes, even with a correct code
steps: From one browser enter 5 wrong/random/revoked codes; then on a different device (same IP) enter a fresh valid code.
expected: Wrong codes lock the device that typed them (and alert); a valid code on another till still claims, or the lock is per counter/code
actual: 429 "Too many failed activation attempts. Counter enrolment is locked for a few minutes" for the valid code from a second device; locked for 15 min.
cause: backend/app/Models/DeviceActivationAttempt.php:36 countRecentFailures() counts failures by ip_address OR device_uuid; CounterClaimService::claim() checks lockedOut() before looking at the code.
fix: Key the lockout on device_uuid (+ per-code attempt counter); keep an IP limit only as a high ceiling for brute force.
test: Feature: 5 failures from device A then valid code from device B on the same IP -> 200.

title: Every till purchase with a bill charge is rejected by the server ("A charge is taxed by the place of supply of its supplier bill, not its own") while the till shows "Purchase Bill Posted! Batch stock credited & supplier ledger updated"
steps: Till QA-PH C01: Purchases > New Inward Bill; supplier QA Pharma Distributors (GSTIN 32…), bill QA-PB-001; 3 lines = 10,000 @12%; Alt+F: Freight 200 @18% add to cost, Packing 100 @18% expense; Ctrl+Enter; Alt+I 11554 (✓ Match); F12; Enter.
expected: Purchase saved on the server: 3 lines, 2 charges, batches + stock ledger + supplier payable 11,554, or a clear failure on the till
actual: POST /api/sync/push/batch -> HTTP 200 {"success":false,…"error":"A charge is taxed by the place of supply of its supplier bill, not its own."}. Server: purchases 0 rows for store 4, no batches, no ledger, supplier balance 0. Till: success modal "TOTAL INWARD ₹ 11554.00 … Batch stock credited & supplier ledger updated."
cause: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/SyncController.php:1404 passes the raw header place_of_supply ("32-State") to PurchaseChargeService::resolveForStore(); backend/app/Services/Purchase/PurchaseChargeService.php:128-129 normalises only the charge value (cleanPos -> "32") and compares it with the raw header, so they never match. PurchaseController.php:120 has the same pattern. Till side: the purchase post flow treats HTTP 200 as success and ignores results.failed.
fix: Normalise $placeOfSupply with cleanPos() at the top of resolveForStore() (and in both callers). On the till, treat success:false / results.failed>0 as a failed post: keep the bill pending, show the server error, and never show the "Posted" modal for an unsaved bill.
test: Feature: sync push of a purchase with place_of_supply "32-State" and charges "32-State" posts and creates purchase_charges; Till test: batch result with failed=1 shows an error, not the success modal.

title: Selecting an existing batch in the purchase grid shows "Batch: CS-A1 (40 on hand)" but leaves batch_no empty, so the line can never be committed ("Please specify batch number")
steps: New Inward Bill > product QA Cough Syrup 100ml > batch cell: type CS-A1, Enter (existing batch picked) > fill expiry/qty/rates > Enter on Sell.
expected: Line committed against existing batch CS-A1
actual: Toast "Please specify batch number"; line stays in the entry row.
cause: Batch combobox selection of an existing batch (PurchaseGridRow.tsx batch cell) sets display/batch_id but not draftLine.batch_no; PurchaseEntryForm.tsx commitEntryRow() checks batch_no.
fix: When an existing batch is picked, copy its batch_no/expiry/mrp into the draft line.
test: DOM test: pick existing batch by keyboard, Enter through to Sell -> line committed with batch_no.

title: Purchase totals, the supplier-total "✓ Match" check and the success modal include the uncommitted entry-row line, but posting drops it
steps: Enter two lines (8,500) and leave a third in the entry row (1,500, see PUR-02); add charges; Alt+I 11554 -> "✓ Match"; F12.
expected: Totals and checks count only committed lines, or posting refuses while the entry row holds a line
actual: Screen SUBTOTAL ₹10,000, NET PAYABLE ₹11,554, "✓ Match", success modal ₹11,554; posted payload subtotal 8,500, tax 1,074, grand 9,874 (2 lines).
evidence: tests/qa/r3/evidence/J3_01_QA-PB-001_partial.json and the first run of J3_01 (payload in post_calls)
cause: PurchaseEntryForm.tsx totals are computed over [...lines, draftLine] while the post payload uses lines only.
fix: Compute totals from committed lines (show the draft separately), or block F12 with a message while the entry row has a product.
test: DOM test: draft line present -> F12 refused or totals exclude it; payload grand equals displayed grand.

title: Purchases list: "New Inward Bill (F2)" has no keyboard handler (F2 and Ctrl+Shift+N do nothing); a mouse is required to start a purchase
steps: Till > F2 (Purchases) > press F2 or Ctrl+Shift+N.
expected: New inward bill form opens
actual: Nothing happens; only clicking the button opens the form.
cause: frontend/src/pages/PurchasesPage.tsx:257-266 button has onClick only; no screen shortcut registered.
fix: Register the screen shortcut (F2 / Ctrl+Shift+N) in the central key map for the purchases list.
test: DOM test: F2 on purchases list opens the entry form.

title: F1 (and F9 "Recall Draft") inside the purchase form trigger global navigation and silently discard the unsaved bill
steps: Purchase form: select supplier, type bill no QA-PROBE-F1, press F1 (published as "Product Entry Row").
expected: Focus product entry row; bill kept
actual: Navigates to POS Billing; reopening the purchase shows an empty form; no draft saved (F9 found none). Keys typed next go into the sales cart (a sale line was added).
cause: Global F1/F9 navigation shortcuts win over the purchase screen scope while the form is open; no unsaved-changes guard on navigation.
fix: Give the open purchase form screen scope over F1/F9 (as the docs state) and add an unsaved-changes guard / auto-draft on navigation.
test: DOM test: F1 in purchase form focuses the entry row and the route does not change.

title: Purchase margin % is wrong for pack products (95.6% for a strip bought at ₹60 and sold at ₹90)
steps: Purchase line QA Paracet 500 Strip (15 per pack): rate 60, selling 90, GST 12% inclusive.
expected: Margin on ex-tax selling price: (80.36-60)/80.36 = 25.3% (or 33.9% on cost)
actual: MARGIN % shows 95.6% = (90 - 60/15)/90: per-tablet cost against per-strip price; margin warnings cannot fire.
cause: Margin cell in PurchaseGridRow.tsx divides purchase rate by units_per_pack but not the selling rate (and uses the tax-inclusive price).
fix: Compute both rates in the same unit and on the same tax basis.
test: Unit test: pack of 15, cost 60, sell 90 incl 12% -> 25.33%.

title: The till leases a new block of 50 invoice numbers on every sync tick, burning the series (C01-INV jumps 1351 -> 4901 -> 4951 -> 5001 … with no bills)
steps: Claim a fresh counter; leave the till open / post a purchase; watch POST /api/counter/sequences/lease.
expected: A block is leased once and reused until exhausted; invoice numbers stay consecutive
actual: Each lease call returns the next block (4901-4950, then 4951-5000, …) though no invoice was issued; the billing screen showed C01-INV-1351 on a brand-new counter.
cause: Till sequence service requests a lease on every sync cycle instead of when the local block is exhausted; server CounterSequenceController::lease always advances.
fix: Lease only when remaining < threshold; server returns the still-open block for the same counter instead of a new one.
test: Feature: two lease calls with no consumption return the same block.

title: The till POSTs its entire local settings document to /api/settings during normal work (purchase post), overwriting server-side store settings
steps: Post a purchase on the till and watch the network.
expected: Till never writes store settings except from its Settings screen with permission
actual: POST /api/settings 200 with the till's full settings (sequences nextInvoiceNumber 1001, printing, tax_mode…). Combined with SEC-02 it is also unauthenticated.
cause: Till settings/sequence persistence writes back to /api/settings on sequence changes.
fix: Stop pushing settings from routine flows; use the counter sequence API only; version-check settings writes.
test: Till test: posting a purchase makes no /api/settings write.

title: Every party is saved with state_code 32 regardless of its GSTIN or the store's state (Maharashtra supplier 27…, Karnataka store customers)
steps: Admin panel (store QA-CS, state 29) > Parties > Add supplier QA Beauty Wholesale MH, GSTIN 27AAACQ5678B1Z2; add customer QA Beauty Client.
expected: Supplier state 27 (from GSTIN), customer state 29 (store state) so CGST/SGST vs IGST is right
actual: parties.state_code = 32 for both (and for every party).
cause: Party create path defaults state_code to "32" (no field in the form, no derivation from GSTIN/store).
fix: Derive state_code from GSTIN when present, else from the store; add the field to the form.
test: Feature: party with GSTIN 27… gets state_code 27; party in a 29 store without GSTIN gets 29.

title: An unconfigured/dev till calls production hosts on first paint (update feed api.lamstonehealthcare.com and GitHub releases); licence check names store 1 before activation
steps: Open the till against a local test backend and watch the network before activation.
expected: Update feed comes from the configured backend/test feed only
actual: Requests to https://api.lamstonehealthcare.com/api/app/update/latest.json and https://github.com/…/releases/latest/download/latest.json (blocked by the harness); GET /api/license/check?store_id=1 before any store is claimed.
cause: Hard-coded production updater endpoints in the front end / tauri.conf.json; licence check defaults to store 1.
fix: Derive update endpoints from the configured server; skip licence checks before claim.
test: Till test with a non-production server makes no requests to other hosts.

title: Admin panel copy defects: "Add Partie" button; version label "v2.0" on a 2.1.1 build; login placeholder admin@alverstone.in
steps: Admin panel > Masters > Parties & Ledgers; sidebar footer; login screen.
expected: "Add Party"; current version; neutral placeholder
actual: As titled.
cause: admin-panel/src/pages/MastersPage.tsx tab label pluralisation; Sidebar version constant; LoginPage placeholder.
fix: Fix the labels; read version from package.json.
test: Snapshot test of labels.

title: POST /api/purchases (counter-authorised till route) saves a "received" purchase but creates no batches, no stock-ledger rows and no payable
steps: As claimed counter C02 (QA-PH): POST /api/purchases {invoice_number:"QA-PB-003", 3 lines PA-CHG/PA-CHG2/CS-CHG, 2 charges, place_of_supply "32"}.
expected: Batches PA-CHG (1500), PA-CHG2 (750), CS-CHG (25) with landed cost, 3 PURCHASE_RECEIPT ledger rows, supplier payable +11,554
actual: 201; purchases id 3 status received, grand 11,554, charges/allocations/expense correct, but product_batches has no PA-CHG/PA-CHG2/CS-CHG rows, 0 ledger rows for the purchase, supplier current_balance 0.
cause: backend/app/Http/Controllers/Api/PurchaseController.php store() writes purchase/purchase_items/charges but never calls the batch + stock-ledger posting used by SyncController::upsertSinglePurchase().
fix: Route both entry points through one PurchasePostingService (batches, landed cost, ledger, payable) inside the same transaction.
test: Feature: POST /api/purchases creates batches and ledger rows whose sum equals purchase_items qty.

title: Duplicate supplier bill number for the same supplier is accepted (two QA-PB-003 purchases, double payable and ITC)
steps: POST /api/purchases twice with supplier_id 8 and invoice_number QA-PB-003.
expected: 409/422 naming the existing bill; one purchase
actual: Both 201; purchases ids 3 and 4 with the same supplier bill number and total 11,554.
cause: No unique rule on (store_id, supplier_id, invoice_number, financial year) in PurchaseController::store() or the purchases table.
fix: Add a unique index and a validation rule that names the existing bill; make sync ingest idempotent on the till external_id.
test: Feature: second POST with same supplier + bill no returns 422 and count stays 1.

title: Supplier current_balance is never updated by purchases (party header 0 while its ledger shows 11,200 owed)
steps: Post credit purchase QA-PB-002 (11,200) from the till; GET /api/admin/suppliers/8/ledger.
expected: current_balance 11,200 = ledger running balance
actual: current_balance 0.00; transactions running_balance 11,200. Screens that read current_balance (outstanding payables tile, party list) show 0.
evidence: tests/qa/r3/evidence/J3_01_QA-PB-002.json; admin ledger response in this run log
cause: Purchase posting (SyncController::upsertSinglePurchase / PurchaseController::store) does not adjust parties.current_balance; the ledger endpoint derives a balance on the fly.
fix: Maintain the balance in the posting service (or drop the column and always derive).
test: Feature: credit purchase 11,200 -> supplier current_balance 11,200 and equals ledger closing balance.

title: Posting a purchase writes no audit-log entry; purchases from the till store the supplier bill number but not the till document number (C01-PUR-…) or place of supply; ledger rows carry no counter code
steps: Post QA-PB-002 from till C01; query audit_logs, purchases, stock_ledger_entries.
expected: Audit row; purchase keeps C01-PUR-1001 and place_of_supply 32; ledger rows carry counter C01
actual: No purchase audit row; purchases.invoice_number = QA-PB-002 only, place_of_supply empty; stock_ledger_entries.counter_code empty.
cause: SyncController::upsertSinglePurchase() maps supplier_invoice_no into invoice_number and drops purchase_number / place_of_supply / counter.
fix: Persist both numbers, the POS and counter; add AuditLog::log on post/edit/cancel.
test: Feature: synced purchase has document_number, supplier_invoice_no, place_of_supply, counter_code and an audit row.

title: Cash tendered is stored as the payment: ₹500 note on a ₹210 bill saves invoice_payments.amount 500 and invoices.paid_amount 500 (change ₹290 counted as takings)
steps: Till C01: sell 2 strips + 5 tablets (₹210.00); F12; type 500 in the cash amount; Ctrl+S.
expected: Payment row ₹210 received (tendered 500, change 290 kept as tender detail); paid_amount 210
actual: invoice C01-INV-8301: paid_amount 500, invoice_payments Cash 500 (request sends paid_amount 210 but payments[0].amount 500). Cash book / collections overstate by the change.
cause: Till PosBillingPage settlement sends tender amount in payments[]; backend InvoiceController::store() sums payments into paid_amount and stores tender rows as received amounts without netting change.
fix: Send applied amount and tendered/change separately; server caps cash received at the balance due and stores change.
test: Feature: cash tender 500 on a 210 bill -> payment 210, paid_amount 210, change 290; collections report = 210.

title: Line discount sent as percent and amount is applied twice: 60% (₹54) on a ₹90 line is stored as discount ₹90, taxable 0, tax 0, total ₹0
steps: As claimed counter: POST /api/invoices with one line unit_price 90, discount_percent 60, discount_amount 54 (the till payload carries both fields).
expected: Line net ₹36.00 (taxable 32.14, tax 3.86) or a refusal above the discount limit
actual: C02-INV-QA011: invoice_items discount_amount 90, taxable 0, tax 0, total 0; invoice grand_total 0, paid 36, payment_status unpaid.
cause: Server tax calculation in InvoiceController::store()/TaxEngine adds percent-derived and absolute discount instead of treating discount_amount as the result of discount_percent.
fix: Accept one discount representation (percent or amount) and derive the other; validate their consistency.
test: Feature/vector: 90 @12% incl, 60% -> total 36.00, taxable 32.14, tax 3.86.

title: A QA-PH counter can sell a QA-CS product: the cosmetics store's batch is decremented and the ledger row is written under the pharmacy store
steps: As QA-PH counter C02: POST /api/invoices with items[0].product_id 9 / batch_id 10 (QA Ruby Lipstick, store 5).
expected: 422 cross-store reference
actual: 201 C02-INV-QA014; product_batches 10 (store 5) stock 25 -> 24; stock_ledger_entries row store_id 4 for batch 10; products 9 current_stock -1.
cause: InvoiceController::store() / stock posting looks up product and batch by id without a store_id constraint.
fix: Scope product/batch lookups by the token's store (constitution rule: cross-store reference is a refused insert).
test: Feature: invoice referencing another store's batch returns 422 and changes nothing.

title: Walk-in bill accepted with a balance due (cash 40 on a 90 bill saved as partially_paid with no customer)
steps: POST /api/invoices walk-in, grand 90, payments Cash 40.
expected: Refused: walk-in must settle in full (same rule as credit for walk-in)
actual: 201 partially_paid, balance 50 owed by nobody.
cause: Credit-for-walk-in rule checks payment_mode=Credit only, not paid < grand.
fix: Refuse any unsettled balance for walk-in customers.
test: Feature: walk-in with paid < grand -> 422.

title: UPI/card payment accepted without a reference number
steps: POST /api/invoices with payments [{mode:UPI, amount:90}] and no reference_no.
expected: Reference required for UPI/card (or store policy)
actual: 201; invoice_payments UPI 90 reference null.
cause: No server rule on reference_no per mode.
fix: Enforce reference rules per mode on the server (the till only hints "12-digit UTR").
test: Feature: UPI without reference -> 422 when policy requires it.

title: Selling price above MRP accepted on a pharmacy bill (₹150 on MRP ₹90)
steps: POST /api/invoices line unit_price 150, mrp 90 (QA-PH).
expected: Refused (MRP capping for pharmacy)
actual: 201 C02-INV-QA013 total 150.
cause: No MRP cap on the server; store feature flag enforce_mrp_capping not applied to new stores.
fix: Enforce MRP cap server-side for stores with the flag (default on for pharmacy).
test: Feature: unit_price > mrp -> 422.

title: Bill number shown on screen differs from the number saved (screen C01-INV-7951, saved C01-INV-8301); the client chooses the final number
steps: Till C01: start a bill (header shows C01-INV-7951); save it.
expected: Saved number equals the one shown/printed, issued from the counter series without gaps
actual: Saved C01-INV-8301; series gaps of ~50-350 between consecutive bills (8301, 8651, 8751, 8901, 9151).
cause: See NUM-01: repeated leases move the local block between preview and save; server accepts the client invoice_number.
fix: Fix leasing (NUM-01) and allocate the final number at save from the current block; show it only after save.
test: Till test: number shown before save equals the saved number; consecutive bills are consecutive.

title: Typing part of a customer name and pressing Enter creates a new customer ("QA Credit") instead of selecting the matching "QA Credit Customer"
steps: Billing: Alt+C, type "QA Credit", Enter.
expected: Select the highlighted match; creating a new party needs an explicit action
actual: parties id 12 "QA Credit" created (credit_limit 0) and linked to the bill.
cause: CustomerCombobox Enter with no explicit selection falls through to quick-create.
fix: Enter selects the first match; quick-create on a separate key with confirmation.
test: DOM test: type prefix + Enter selects the existing party.

title: Karnataka store bills local walk-in sales as inter-state: place_of_supply "32-Kerala", IGST ₹72 instead of CGST ₹36 + SGST ₹36
steps: Till QA-CS (state 29) C01: sell QA Ruby Lipstick ₹400 + 18% (exclusive) to walk-in; save.
expected: place_of_supply 29; CGST 36.00 + SGST 36.00; total 472.00
actual: C01-INV-1051: place_of_supply "32-Kerala", store_state_code 29, cgst 0, sgst 0, igst 72.00 (total 472.00 correct). GSTR-1 would report it as inter-state.
cause: frontend/src/lib/sync/onlineTransactionService.ts:558 sends place_of_supply: payload.place_of_supply || "32-Kerala"; frontend/src/lib/masters/partiesStore.ts:371 and :416 give the walk-in party place_of_supply "32-Kerala"; the server trusts the client value (see also MST-01).
fix: Default place of supply to the store state for walk-in/B2C; derive from customer GSTIN/state otherwise; server recomputes intra/inter from store state vs POS.
test: Feature + till test: store 29, walk-in -> place_of_supply 29, CGST/SGST split.

title: Sales return of an inclusive-priced line adds GST on top: 5 tablets sold at ₹6.00 incl. are refunded ₹33.60 (taxable 30.00 + tax 3.60) instead of ₹30.00 (26.79 + 3.21)
steps: Till C01: sell 2 strips + 5 tablets QA Paracet (₹210.00, 12% incl) -> F7 > New Return > pick the bill > tick line, Return Qty 5 units, Restock > Next: Payment > Cash > Save & Print Credit Note.
actual: Screen "₹ 33.60 credit"; C01-SR-1001: taxable_subtotal 30.00, tax 3.60, CGST 1.80, SGST 1.80, grand_total 34 (rounded) but paid_amount 33.60. Stock +5 and SALES_RETURN ledger row are correct.
cause: Till salesReturnService/posSalesReturnService prices the return line as unit_price × qty and then applies GST as if exclusive, ignoring the original invoice tax mode; grand_total is rounded independently of paid_amount.
fix: Reverse each returned unit at the original line's taxable and tax per unit (proportional to the original line), keep paisa; round-off consistently and store grand = refund.
test: Vector: inclusive 210 bill, return 5/35 -> 30.00 (26.79 + 3.21); server re-derives the return from the original line.

title: Return screen shows batch expiry as a raw UTC timestamp one day early ("Exp: 2027-03-30T18:30:00.000000Z" for 31-03-2027)
steps: F7 > New Return > load a bill.
cause: SalesReturnPage renders the server datetime string without formatting in the store time zone.
fix: Format with the shared date formatter in the store time zone.
test: DOM test: expiry renders 03/27.

title: Keyboard gaps in sales: "New Return (F7)" has no handler; return search results cannot be picked with arrows/Enter; F1 from another screen lands on billing with no focus; settlement shows two conflicting mode maps ("1=Cash, 2=UPI, 3=Card, 4=Credit, 5=Split" vs buttons [4] Bank Transfer … [8] Credit) and Alt+2/Alt+8 did not add UPI/Credit lines
steps: F7 then F7; type a bill no, ArrowDown, Enter; Dashboard > F1 then type; F12 then Alt+2 / Alt+8.
expected: Each works from the keyboard as labelled
actual: As titled; mouse needed to open a return and pick the bill; a cash 50 + UPI attempt by keyboard saved as a single cash tender of 90.
cause: SalesReturnPage has no screen shortcut; result list is not a listbox; PosBillingPage settlement key maps disagree (lines ~1420-1490).
fix: Register screen shortcuts; make results a keyboard listbox; one mode map shown and used.
test: DOM tests for each key path.

title: Transfer receive matches products by barcode alone: 30 tablets of QA Paracet (QA-PH) were received as 30 jars of "QA Glow Face Cream 50g" at QA-CS
steps: QA-PH counter: POST /api/stock/transfers {to_store_id:5, lines:[{product_id:5, batch_no:PA-NEW, qty:30}]}. QA-CS counter: POST /api/stock/transfers/1/receive. (Barcode 8909000000011 is QA Paracet in QA-PH and QA Glow Face Cream in QA-CS — allowed per J2.05.)
expected: Barcode match confirmed against name/HSN/pack size or the receiver chooses; otherwise create-on-receive
actual: resolutions dest_product_id 8 "QA Glow Face Cream 50g" matched_by barcode; QA-CS batch PA-NEW (product 8) +30; transfer_product_mappings row saved so every later transfer repeats it.
cause: StockController::receiveTransfer() / transfer product resolver maps by barcode first without checking name, HSN, GST rate or units_per_pack, and persists the mapping.
fix: Require a confirmed mapping (barcode + name/HSN/pack match) or receiver choice; never auto-map when attributes differ; offer create-on-receive.
test: Feature: same barcode, different HSN/name -> receive asks for mapping or creates a new product.

title: Short receipt is ignored: receiving 25 of 30 books 30 into the destination and records no shortage
steps: POST /api/stock/transfers/1/receive {lines:[{item_id:1, received_qty:25}]}.
expected: 25 received, 5 shortage recorded (in transit / loss) and visible to both stores
actual: Response qty 30; destination +30; no shortage row; transfer status received.
cause: receiveTransfer() ignores lines.*.received_qty and posts the dispatched qty.
fix: Post received_qty, record the difference as shortage with a reason.
test: Feature: receive 25 of 30 -> TRANSFER_IN +25, shortage 5.

title: Store policy "max documents per day" never applies to counters (5 adjustments posted with a limit of 3); no cumulative units-per-day limit exists
steps: Admin PUT /api/admin/stock-adjustments/policy {max_documents_per_day:3, approval_threshold_qty:100, require_notes:true}; counter posts 5 small adjustments.
expected: 4th and later refused (or held) for the counter
actual: All posted (201). The 120-unit document was correctly held for approval; notes and negative-stock rules worked.
cause: backend/app/Services/StockAdjustmentPolicy.php:180-190 counts documents only when $user is set (created_by); counter-authorised requests have no user.
fix: Count per counter (and per store) when no person is on the request; add a units-per-day limit if required.
test: Feature: counter posts limit+1 documents -> last refused.

title: A counter can cancel any invoice of its store with no approval (no manager PIN / one-time PIN needed server-side); cancelled_by stays empty
steps: As counter C02: POST /api/invoices/{id}/cancel {reason:"…"} for C01-INV-8651 (sold on C01).
expected: Cancel requires an approval token (manager/OTP) per store policy, and records who approved
actual: 200 cancelled; cancelled_by null; no approval row consumed.
cause: InvoiceController::cancel() never calls the approval check (ApprovalService::assertSettled is a Wave C item); approval tokens from /approvals/verify are not required.
fix: Require and consume an approval token for cancel/edit; stamp counter and approver.
test: Feature: cancel without approval token -> 403; with token -> 200 and token consumed.

title: A closed business day does not block cancellation: after the admin closed 21-11-2026 a bill of that date was cancelled
steps: Admin POST /api/admin/day-close/close {close_date:"2026-11-21"} (200); counter POST /api/invoices/{C02-INV-QA002}/cancel.
expected: Refused unless an audited override
actual: 200 "cancelled and batch stock restored"; the closed day's totals change.
cause: InvoiceController::cancel() calls StoreDayCloseService::assertDayOpen() but the admin day-close (AdminDayCloseController::close) records a different state than the one assertDayOpen reads.
fix: Use one closed-day source for both; add an override path with audit.
test: Feature: close day then cancel -> 409.

title: Offline bills are renumbered on sync: the till showed C01-INV-11002/11003/11004, the server stored them as 11001/11002/11003, and the first offline bill synced last
steps: Till C01 offline: save 3 bills (1, 2, 3 bottles). Reconnect.
expected: Each bill keeps the number shown/printed; synced in order, exactly once
actual: Exactly once and amounts right, but the bill printed as 11002 (1 bottle) is stored as 11001 and the screen number of every bill is off by one; created order 2,3,1.
cause: Offline numbering and the lease/renumber path (NUM-01, renumbered[] in /sync/push/batch) reassign numbers on push; queue not FIFO.
fix: Freeze the number at save from a leased block; never renumber a printed bill; push in creation order.
test: Till test: offline bills keep numbers after sync; server order equals local order.

title: A counter locked by the admin can still create invoices (POST /api/invoices 201), and bills without counter_code are credited to the store's first counter (C01) instead of the token's counter (C02)
steps: Admin POST /api/admin/counters/3/lock; counter C02 token: GET /api/store (403 locked) then POST /api/invoices.
expected: Every write from a locked counter refused; invoices stamped with the token's counter
actual: POST /api/invoices 201 C02-INV-LOCKED with counter_id 2 / C01. Same mis-attribution for C02-INV-QA-AFTERCLOSE.
cause: /invoices is outside counter.auth (SEC-01) so the lock check in AuthenticateCounterOrUser never runs; InvoiceController resolves the counter from payload/defaults, not from the device token.
fix: Put /invoices under counter.auth; stamp counter from the token only.
test: Feature: locked counter POST /invoices -> 403; unlocked -> invoice.counter_id = token counter.

title: Counter shift open and close crash with HTTP 500 "Undefined array key opened_at" (CounterShiftService.php:73 and :106)
steps: Counter C02 (unlock PIN set): POST /api/counter/shift/open {pin, opening_float:1000}; POST /api/counter/shift/close {pin, closing_cash_actual:1100, …}.
expected: Shift opened; close computes expected cash 1,115 from server documents and records a 15 short difference
actual: 500 ErrorException at backend/app/Services/Counter/CounterShiftService.php:73 (open) and :106 (close); no counter_shifts row. Close also accepts client cash_sales/digital_sales figures.
cause: CounterShiftService reads $data["opened_at"] (and similar) without a default; the controller does not pass it.
fix: Default opened_at/closed_at to now(); compute expected cash from invoices/payments on the server, not from client totals.
test: Feature: open/close a shift with mixed modes -> expected 1,115, counted 1,100, difference -15.

title: Customer receipts and supplier payments are not allocated to documents: the paid invoice stays "unpaid", purchases keep paid_amount 0; supplier balance goes to -5,000
steps: POST /api/payments/customer {customer_id:6, amount:90, notes:"against C02-INV-QA005"}; POST /api/payments/supplier {supplier_id:8, amount:5000}.
expected: Allocation to C02-INV-QA005 (paid) and to QA-PB-002 (paid 5,000, outstanding 6,200)
actual: Customer balance 90 -> 0 but invoice payment_status unpaid, paid_amount 0; supplier current_balance -5,000 (purchases never raised it, PAY-01); purchases.paid_amount 0. Ledger running balance includes the duplicate QA-PB-003 (PUR-06).
cause: AdminTransactionController::storeCustomerPayment/storeSupplierPayment accept no allocations and only move parties.current_balance.
fix: Add allocations (document id + amount), update document paid/payment_status, keep party balance derived from documents.
test: Feature: receipt allocated to an invoice marks it paid and outstanding reports drop it.

title: No way to record an expense (cash from drawer, bank, on credit) at the till or through the API; only purchase-charge expenses exist
steps: Look for an Expenses screen in the QA-PH till menu and an expenses route in routes/api.php.
expected: Expense entry with payment source affecting cash book / bank book / payables
actual: No till menu item (QA stores enabled_menu_items lack "expenses"); no /api/expenses route; expenses table only filled by purchase charges.
cause: Feature absent / not enabled for new stores.
fix: Provide expense entry (till + panel) with cash-drawer integration, or document it as out of scope.
test: Feature: cash expense reduces expected drawer cash.

title: Admin GSTR-1 Table 7 (B2CS) reports tax-inclusive amounts as taxable value (₹3,977.00 vs ₹3,443.79) and counts the credit note as a sale; it disagrees with the till GSTR-1
steps: After the QA-PH journeys: GET /api/admin/reports/gstr1?store_id=4&from=2026-11-21&to=2026-11-21 and GET /api/reports/gstr-1 as the counter.
expected: B2CS taxable 3,443.79, tax 413.21 for sales; credit note 30.00/3.60 in Table 9 only (oracle from invoice lines)
actual: Admin: table_7_b2cs taxable 3,977.00 (= sum(invoices.subtotal), which includes GST), tax 416.81, invoice_value 3,891.00, count 22 (credit note included as a positive doc). Till: 3,443.79 / 413.21 + Table 9 note.
cause: AdminReportController gstr1 sums invoices.subtotal (gross) as taxable and does not filter module_key=invoice / net credit notes.
fix: Build both GSTR-1s from one service using line taxable/tax with module_key filtering.
test: Report test: fixture with inclusive bills + credit note -> admin and till GSTR-1 equal the oracle to the paisa.

title: Admin dashboard "sales today" adds credit notes instead of subtracting them (₹3,891 / 22 vs net ₹3,823 / 21); receivables tile shows 0 with unpaid walk-in and credit balances; purchases tile counts the duplicate and stock-less bills
steps: GET /api/admin/dashboard?store_id=4 after the journeys; compare with Daily Summary and the oracle.
expected: Net sales 3,823.00 (21 bills), receivables = sum of open balances, purchases without duplicates
actual: sales.today 3,891 / 22; receivables.total_outstanding 0; purchases.today 34,308 (includes duplicate QA-PB-003 and PUR-05 bill).
cause: AdminDashboardController sums all non-cancelled invoices regardless of module_key; receivables read parties.current_balance (not maintained, PAY-01/PAY-05).
fix: Use the shared sales metric (net of credit notes) and derive receivables from document balances.
test: Dashboard equals Daily Summary for the same window.

title: Daily collection report taxable/tax (₹3,977 / ₹416.81) disagree with Daily Summary, dashboard GST slabs and the oracle (₹3,413.79 / ₹409.61); cash collection includes change returned to customers
steps: GET /api/reports/daily-collection?date=2026-11-21 as the counter.
expected: Taxable 3,413.79, tax 409.61; cash = cash received net of change and refunds
actual: total_taxable 3,977 (gross), total_tax 416.81 (ignores the credit note); by_tender Cash 3,650.40 includes the ₹290 change of C01-INV-8301 (PAY-02). Dashboard total_collected 4,010.40 vs net sales 3,823.
cause: ReportController::dailyCollection uses subtotal as taxable and raw tender rows.
fix: Same shared metric service; tenders from applied amounts.
test: Report parity test across dashboard, daily summary, daily collection, GSTR-1.

title: API money values carry float noise (cgst_amount 204.81999999999994) in dashboard GST slabs
steps: GET /api/dashboard/metrics as the counter.
expected: Two-decimal strings or rounded numbers
cause: Sums of floats returned without rounding.
fix: Sum in paise/decimal and round to 2 places.
test: Unit test on the metric serializer.

title: A till revoked while offline keeps working after reconnect (no lock), its offline bill is never synced and no error is shown; header shows "Counter C01" on C02
steps: Till QA-CS C02 online -> go offline -> sell 1 lipstick (C02-INV-1052) -> admin re-issues C02 (device revoked) -> reconnect, wait 45 s.
expected: Till locks to the activation screen on reconnect; queued offline bill is accepted (per CR Q1) or clearly flagged for the owner
actual: Till stays on the store shell; GET /counter/profile-version 403/401, POST /device-sessions/heartbeat 403, POST /sync/push/batch 401 repeating; server has 0 new QA-CS invoices; no message to the cashier.
cause: Till treats 401/403 from sync/heartbeat as transient (CounterGrace/A12 revocation handling not wired to these responses); queued documents of a revoked device have no server path.
fix: On 401/403 device errors lock the till and keep the queue; provide an owner-side import of stranded offline documents.
test: Till test: heartbeat 403 -> lock screen; queued docs preserved and reported.

title: No audit entries for invoice cancellation (4 cancels), purchase posting, or counter claims; only the activation lockout raised an alert (no low-stock, negative-stock, large-discount or counter-offline alerts)
steps: Run the journeys; GET audit_logs grouped by action for stores 4 and 5; list notifications.
expected: Audit row for every sensitive action; alerts for negative stock (Alprazolam -10, lipstick -2), the 60% discount, offline counter
actual: audit actions present: create_store, counter_*, create_product/party, invoice_create_authoritative, stock adjustments, approvals, day close… none for invoice cancel, purchase post, counter claim. notifications: 1 row (counter_claim_lockout).
cause: InvoiceCancellationService, purchase posting and CounterClaimService do not call AuditLog::log; alert generators for stock/discount/offline not wired to these events.
fix: Add audit calls in those services; raise notifications on negative stock, discount above limit, counter offline > N min.
test: Feature: cancel/purchase/claim each write one audit row; negative-stock sale raises an alert.

title: Admin counter list API carries no last bill time, last salesperson, unsynced items or offline periods
steps: GET /api/admin/counters?store_id=4 after bills from both counters.
expected: Per counter: status, last salesperson, last bill time, unsynced items, offline periods
actual: Only status, last_seen_at, device; the rest null/absent (UI shows "Last salesperson None yet", "Unsynced items: 0").
cause: Counter resource does not join invoices / sync queue / presence history; salespeople are Wave D.
fix: Add the fields from invoices and heartbeat history.
test: Feature: counter list returns last_bill_at after a bill.

title: Purchase returns pushed through sync are "processed" but saved without lines, move no stock, reverse no payable/ITC, are not blocked when the batch was sold, and a second return overwrites the first
steps: As counter C02: POST /api/sync/push/batch with entity purchase, module_key purchase_return, original QA-PB-002: (1) 50 strips PA-OLD (750 tablets, ~435 on hand); (2) 5 strips PA-NEW @60 (336.00).
expected: (1) refused: stock already sold; (2) return saved with its line, PA-NEW -75 tablets, supplier payable -336, ITC -36; a retry is idempotent
actual: Both answered processed:1. purchases has a single row "PR-4-1795278987" (subtotal 300, tax 36) — the second overwrote the first; purchase_items for it: 0; PA-OLD and PA-NEW stock unchanged; supplier balance unchanged.
cause: SyncController::upsertSinglePurchase() return branch (lines ~1432-1470) builds Purchase::firstOrNew on a generated number per second, does not persist return lines from items[], and the debit-note posting (stock out / payable / ITC) is not invoked for module purchase_return. Replayed payload shape from the till's purchase push; not yet confirmed through the till Purchase Returns screen (Shift+F2).
fix: Post returns through the same posting service with lines, stock-out per batch with on-hand check, payable and ITC reversal, idempotent on external_id.
test: Feature: purchase return push with one line -> purchase_items row, ledger -qty, supplier balance -total; over on-hand -> 422.

title: Billing screen has no quick-add for an unknown product: typing a new name shows no "add new product" option and no "not found" message
steps: Billing: F1, type "QA Zinc Quickadd Tab", Enter.
expected: Option to create the product with the typed name prefilled (as on the purchase screen)
actual: No dropdown, no message; Enter does nothing.
cause: PosBillingPage search shows only matches; ProductQuickAddModal is mounted only in PurchaseEntryForm.
fix: Offer the quick-add option in billing search (profile-gated).
test: DOM test: unknown name in billing shows "Add new product" with the name prefilled.

title: At 1366×768 the billing hint bar pushes Recall (Alt+L), New Bill (Ctrl+N) and Columns off-screen
steps: Till at 1366×768 > F1 billing.
expected: All hint chips visible or wrapped
actual: Three chips beyond the right edge (clipped).
cause: PosShortcutHintBar uses a single non-wrapping row.
fix: Wrap or collapse into a "More" chip under 1440 px.
test: Visual test at 1366.

title: Update manifest served by the backend carries the placeholder signature "untrusted" (base64 dW50cnVzdGVk) and offers 2.1.0 clients a package that is not on the server
steps: GET /api/app/update/latest.json and /api/app/update/windows-x86_64/2.1.0 on the test backend; GET the advertised download.
expected: No update offered without a real signed package; signature verifies
actual: Manifest signature "untrusted"; url …/download/LamSuite-Billing_2.1.1_x64-setup.nsis.zip offered; missing file returns 404 with a stack trace (APP_DEBUG).
cause: DesktopUpdateController builds the manifest from config defaults when no signed artefact is registered.
fix: Return 204 unless a signed artefact exists; never emit placeholder signatures.
test: Feature: without a registered artefact the manifest endpoint returns 204.

title: Salesperson on the bill is not implemented: no salesperson field, bills save without one, no salesperson reports/incentives (planned Wave D, v2.3.0)
steps: Till billing screen; save a bill; admin counter card "Last salesperson".
expected: Salesperson required on every bill (store default), reported and used for incentives
actual: No field; invoices.user_id null; counter card "None yet"; no salesperson report.
cause: Feature scheduled for Wave D; CounterContextController lists salesperson_pins as not shipped.
fix: Deliver Wave D (D1-D16).
test: Wave D tests listed in task-delta.md.

title: Pharmacist rule is not implemented: no restricted-drug flag, no pharmacist PIN/registration, restricted items sell freely (planned Wave E, v2.4.0)
steps: Admin product form (no schedule/restricted field); till sells QA Alprazolam 0.25 Strip with no prompt.
expected: Restricted drug bill cannot be saved without a pharmacist PIN; registration stored; expired registration refused
actual: Sold (C02-INV-QA010) with no gate; users table has no registration fields.
cause: Wave E not started (E1-E10).
fix: Deliver Wave E.
test: PharmacistGateTest etc. per task-delta.md.

title: Discount / price-override approval prompts are not enforced: a 60% line discount and a price above MRP save without approval (profile allows max_pct 100; approvals are Wave C)
steps: POST /api/invoices with discount_percent 60; counter profile shows discount.max_pct 100, approval_pct null.
expected: Store/counter discount limit with approval above it
actual: Saved (and mis-computed, TAX-01); no limit by default; no approval check server-side.
cause: Default counter profile grants 100%; ApprovalService enforcement is Wave C.
fix: Sensible default limits; Wave C enforcement.
test: Feature: discount above limit without approval -> 403.

title: API errors return full exception traces with server file paths (APP_DEBUG=true in backend/.env)
steps: Any 404/500, e.g. GET /api/admin/parties/8/ledger.
expected: JSON error without trace in shipped configs
actual: exception, file, line and trace array with /Users/… paths.
cause: backend/.env APP_DEBUG=true (dev file in repo); production config should set false.
fix: Ensure production/staging set APP_DEBUG=false; render JSON errors without trace.
test: Deployment check: APP_DEBUG false.
